svg.title: From uploaded asset to a file served at media.{domain}
svg.desc: The api Worker's createAsset mints a short-lived signed PUT URL, and the uploaded bytes land in the R2 media bucket ①. R2's object-create notification, and the api's own upload event as a second trigger, reach the engine through the contentworker-asset-events queue, which starts exactly one AssetIngestWorkflow run per file version ②. The run reads the bytes back from R2 to hash them, probes dimensions and builds a placeholder with the Images binding, asks Workers AI through AI Gateway for alt text, tags, extracted text and embeddings, indexes the asset in its SearchShard objects and Vectorize namespace, and records each step in D1 ③. Publishing the asset commits its published snapshot and an asset.published outbox row to D1 ④, and when the engine consumes that event, syncAssetGate writes the media gate entry in KV; the engine is the only writer of the gate ⑤. A reader requests a published file URL on the media host ⑥. The uncached media gateway checks the URL's token before anything else, negotiates AVIF or WebP from Accept for a variant, and forwards a canonical URL to the cached Media entrypoint ⑦; it also serves Preview's short-lived signed draft reads straight from R2, uncached ⑧. On a cache miss the Media entrypoint reads the gate, falling back to a D1 replica, and serves the original from R2 or a variant transformed by Images, cached as immutable ⑨.
